facts.business: Kanishk Aluminium India Limited manufactures a comprehensive range of aluminium extrusion products including solid & hollow section profiles, solar profiles, railings, heatsinks, and sliding/fixed windows and doors profiles for industries such as electronics, automotive, mechanical, solar, furniture, transport, electrical, and architecture.
key_risks: Aluminium price volatility set at London Metal Exchange
Growing imports of aluminium products and scrap
Real estate and construction cycle volatility
facts.related_party_note: Proposed related party transactions for FY 2026-27: up to ₹60 crore with P N Agarwal & Co. and up to ₹50 crore with Kanishk Metals, both on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business.
